how: 10 summaries picked at random (seed 7) from the 30-day backfill. Each was read side by side with its openFDA source record and graded supported / partly / not.

results.note: Teva, metoclopramide, foreign tablets: all in source.
K.C. Pharmaceuticals eye drops, sterility: matches.
Class II, toothpaste, CGMP deviations: matches.
Tri-Mix syringes, sterility tied to processing equipment: matches.
Cipla fosfomycin, failed impurity specs: matches.
K.C. Pharmaceuticals redness eye drops: matches.
Says the boxed warning was 'updated'. The source shows the label was updated and has this boxed warning; it does not say the warning itself changed. Prompt fixed for future runs.
Brush Buddies chocolate toothpaste, CGMP: matches.

why_it_matters_check: Oct 28 issue says Greenwich Rx and Par Health recalls are Class I. Checked: D-0084-2027 and D-0082-2027 are both Class I. Supported.
known_limit: The automatic name check flags 2 label lines as mismatches because openFDA left the product name blank; the AI took the name from the warning text. Shown, not hidden.
